detector.name: K8s pod phase pending/failed within 5 min
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.autodetect.infra.k8s import pod
pod.pods_in_failed_or_pending_phase().publish('K8s pod phase pending/failed')

rules.description: The value of k8s.pod.phase - Mean(5m) is within 1 and 1 for 5m OR The value of k8s.pod.phase - Mean(5m) is within 4 and 4 for 5m.
